name: vector_index_search
description: Builds and searches a local vector index using an explicitly configured localhost embedding endpoint such as Ollama. Use when TF-IDF semantic_search is insufficient and an agent needs embedding-based relevance. Indexing writes a local JSON index only after confirm_write=true; embedding requests are rejected unless the endpoint is localhost. Not for remote embedding APIs or automatic background indexing.

action.description: Use index to build a local index or search to query an existing one.

path.description: Directory to index. Required for action=index.

index_path.description: Explicit local path for the JSON vector index.

model.description: Embedding model served by the local endpoint.

file_extensions.description: Optional source file extension filter when indexing.

confirm_write.description: Must be true to create or overwrite the index file.
